text:
anya: heads up — vendor emailed that us-central1-rack-17 slice allocated for demo tomorrow at 09:00. they flagged a billing hold on the company card, so allocation is pending. can someone confirm CC update or temporary credit? @procurement
carlos: filing a quick PO request now, pinging procurement team. @procurement-bot can you attach vendor invoice?
procurement-bot: Invoice attached: https://vendor.example/invoice/333 — status: pending-approval
maria: finance here — card on file expired last week, need reprovisioned in stripe. can someone loop in billing? we can do temporary corporate credit if procurement approves.
devon: from infra side, we also need an IAM service account with permission to claim the reservation: `roles/compute.admin` on project:redwood-demo. If procurement is doing the claim, they can run:
```
# example command to reserve the rack slice
gcloud compute reservations create demo-slice --zone=us-central1-a --specific-reservation
```
anya: thanks. @carlos can you add that role to `svc-demo-claim@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`?
carlos: opened PR to add the binding — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2291. tagging infra reviewers.
procurement: we can approve a temp credit up to $5k for this demo, but need vendor T&Cs and invoice number on the PO. @maria can you confirm finance ok with $5k?
maria: confirmed we can cover up to $5k on temporary corporate credit. need invoice #333 and signed PO before we release payment.
oncall-bot: Allocation status update: us-central1-rack-17 tentative hold until payment released. Will auto-release in 48h if unresolved. :alarm_clock:
anya: plan: procurement to upload signed PO + confirm CC, infra will claim once PR merges. tagging @oncall for visibility if we hit the auto-release window.
carlos: PR merged and infra ran the `gcloud` command, slice claimed, vendor confirms allocation. closing loop :tada:
maria: invoiced and charged, finance updated. all good.
